title: Isolate invalid quarantined successor receipts from unrelated starts
outOfScope: Editing, deleting, archiving, or otherwise mutating the foreign linked worktree or its receipt.
Permitting the receipt-bound task to start from an invalid receipt.
Implementing report ownership correction #638 or parallel projection correction #664.
Merging, releasing, or deleting branches outside this Work Item lifecycle.

sources.reason: The global receipt scan currently rejects an unrelated start before its Contract can be created.
Regression coverage defines receipt-bound and unrelated-start behavior.
Reopened corrective issue records the missed invalid-receipt isolation path.
Its failed standard start supplies the observed governed deadlock.

rawUserRequest: Execute the complete approved remediation plan autonomously, record authority in every Work Item Contract, and resolve process defects through governed corrective Work Items rather than temporary bypasses. The attempted #638 start was blocked by an unrelated invalid quarantined receipt, so reopen #737 and correct that missing path without mutating foreign evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The correction changes the fail-closed startup boundary and must preserve invalid receipt diagnostics for the bound task.

reasons: A systemic lifecycle deadlock prevents unrelated Work Item creation.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized autonomous corrective implementation; this self-only bootstrap exists because normal ai-start failed before it could write the corrective evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Bootstrap writes only this Work Item's evidence before normal lifecycle execution resumes; foreign evidence remains read-only.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record immutable implementation and finish checkpoints for this high-risk lifecycle correction.

acceptance: An invalid quarantined successor receipt in a foreign linked worktree does not prevent a different dedicated Work Item from starting.
The task named by an invalid receipt remains fail-closed with a precise receipt diagnostic.
A valid receipt continues to admit only its exact task, branch, and base commit without globally blocking unrelated Work Items.
Regression coverage proves the unrelated invalid-receipt path and preserves all valid-receipt restrictions.
Lifecycle documentation and generated capability evidence describe the bounded behavior.
guidelines: Preserve foreign Work Item evidence and worktrees without mutation.
Use executable regressions for every receipt-validity boundary.
Keep the exception task-specific; no generic bypass of invalid evidence is permitted.

intent.problem: A stale invalid quarantined receipt in an unrelated linked worktree blocks normal ai-start for #638 before it can create its Contract, recreating a governance bootstrap deadlock.
constraints: Do not change the foreign receipt or linked worktree.
The invalid receipt must remain fail-closed for its bound task.
Only unrelated Work Items may be isolated from that diagnostic.
intent.rationale: Receipt integrity must remain strict without allowing obsolete foreign evidence to globally halt independent governed work.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An unrelated Work Item starts while a foreign linked worktree has an invalid quarantined receipt.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The foreign receipt is preserved and the unrelated start is not rejected by that receipt.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Build a linked-worktree fixture with a digest-mismatched receipt and assert no issue for a different requested task.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The task named by the invalid receipt attempts to start.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The start remains fail-closed with its invalid receipt reason.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the same fixture and assert the bound requested task receives the exact invalid-receipt diagnostic.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A valid quarantined receipt binds only its predecessor and named successor identities.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The exact successor requires its recorded branch and base, while unrelated Work Items remain startable.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Assert exact-successor admission, branch/base rejection, and unrelated-task admission in the linked-worktree regression.
